[[Droknar]] was a king of the [[Dwarves]], long ago, when the tribes of [[Deldrimor]] were united under one banner. The king's seat during Droknar's reign, and the capital of the nation, is the city now known as [[Droknar's Forge]].

==Dialogue==
If your [[character]] has not received a [[Droknar's Key]]:
:''"I am Droknar, ancient leader of the Dwarves. Our time as a race is drawing to a close. Those who have undergone [[Rite of the Great Dwarf|the rite]] have become weapons that will conquer or perish trying. It is their final duty to hold the line. I come to you now in thanks for what you have done, not only for my people but for all of [[Tyria (world)|Tyria]]. Our ancient treasures are yours. Please take this now and claim your reward. When you are ready to leave I can send you back to the [[Eye of the North (outpost)|Eye of the North]]."''
:'''{{yes}} Thank you, Droknar.''' (A Droknar's Key is placed in your [[inventory]].)
:'''{{no|ingame}} The Dwarves owe me nothing.''' (Closes dialogue window.)
:;{{no}} I'll be on my way.
